methodology.worker_processes: Fresh child process for each complete run; serial CPU/GPU trials in alternating order
methodology.operating_system_file_cache: Warm; file cache was not forcibly cleared
methodology.cuda_initialization: Fresh process CUDA initialization and first compile/cache load included; disk kernel cache retained
methodology.full_run_scope: Complete production processor call, including CINE reads, canonical upstream modules and declared device boundaries, all Q/T/W outputs, real-time provenance, statistics, CSV/PNG/SVG, source second revision verification and successful atomic publication
methodology.validation_scope: Parent validation against saved output occurs after worker timing; all output values/references/CSV, output contract, input source and actual device policy checked
methodology.job_timer: scopes.job_call_seconds measures the full process_sequence_job call; process_wall_seconds also includes interpreter startup/import/worker report overhead
methodology.phase_medians: Each phase median is independent; do not add them and present the sum as a measured same-trial total
methodology.gpu_policy: Saved GPU policy: inherited GPU stages with explicitly CPU alignment; CPU policy explicitly selects CPU for all active stages
methodology.prototype_comparison: No policy equivalence is claimed with the earlier dedicated GPU prototype, which gathered and calibrated on CPU; these trials execute the real processor and retain the saved mixed boundaries
methodology.gpu_timer: Bounded sampled CUDA event stream regions for registered g2 kernels; includes event/launch gaps, excludes unmeasured launches and other GPU work. Do not extrapolate, label as pure activity duration, or add to exclusive host times
methodology.logical_time_reuse: lag_time_cache_hits counts reused array samples, not repeated Python source dictionary calls
methodology.historical_timing: Historical elapsed values are saved single observations. No repeated old/new full-Q speedup guarantee is claimed

verification.precision_note: All Q/T and W CPU trials are bitwise equal. W saved-GPU-policy trials have maximum absolute difference 2.220446049250313e-16 and pass the unchanged strict 2e-13 tolerance.

full_test_suite.cuda: Required real CUDA; no skipped tests

historical_Q_reference.interpretation: Historical single 0.9.3 Q run divided by 0.9.4 three-run median; useful reference, not a repeated controlled before/after speedup guarantee

baseline.role: Saved numerical/provenance validation baseline; historical timing is one observation, not a repeated before/after benchmark

gpu_timing.semantics: Sum of sampled CUDA-event stream intervals around the registered fused g2 kernel calls, including bounded sequential output blocks. Includes event/launch gaps; not pure kernel activity time or full-pipeline GPU time. First call of each dtype/shape/stride layout is excluded to avoid JIT compilation gaps. Each kernel's first 8 calls are candidates; thereafter every 32 calls has one candidate, reducing measurement overhead. Transfers, conversions, other CuPy kernels and excluded calls are not measured. No extrapolation. Multiple stream intervals may overlap; do not add to exclusive host seconds.
